newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Surgical to redeem preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Surgical to redeem preferred shares.

text.p: United States Surgical Corp on Tuesday said it would call for redemption of all outstanding shares of its series A covertible preferred stock on April 1.
The preferred stock will be redeemed a price equal to $20.50 in market value of common stock, together with an additional quarterly dividend, the company said.
Holders of the series A convertible preferred stock, however, have the option to convert their shares into 0.953 share of common stock, U.S. Surgical said.
The company said it expected most holders of the preferred stock to convert their investments into common shares.
